prompt: Integrate @remcostoeten/auth-drawer into my React + Vite app as a paywall. Backend is my own Express API with JWT auth: POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/logout, GET /api/auth/me, token in a Bearer header. Show it as a MODAL (not a drawer), with NO social login buttons, and auto-open when the reader scrolls about a third down the article. Give me the components.

assertions.text: Wraps the app in the real AuthProvider (from the package) with the adapter, and renders <AuthDrawer>
Session/header uses useAuth() (the real hook) rather than a hand-rolled provider/hook
Handles CSS correctly: relies on the package's out-of-the-box styles and does NOT present a manual styles.css import as required
No nonexistent/invented imports or props (no createAdapterError import, no invented hooks/flags)
OAuth disabled via providers: [] (or omitting signInWithOAuth), not an invented flag
Shared createAuthTriggerStore passed to AuthDrawer via triggerStore; scroll wired with useScrollOpenTrigger emitting {kind:'scrollOpen'}
triggers.scrollOpen threshold ~0.33 and hideTrigger on AuthDrawer
